**Seat ruling amended: what "fleet author" means on this card.** The claim (6585217502) read a fleet author as any `[bot]` App. The contract review (PR #29572, 6586209918) showed that seat-operated human accounts also file cards, and this card's own measurement excluded seat posts. So the reading is now: a card is fleet-authored when its author is a `[bot]` App, or its body's first non-blank line is a seat signature (`<seat> · <account> · session_…`, read by the existing `readSignatureLine`). A non-fleet card is a human account's card that does not open with a seat signature. PR #29572 applies this in `h67ReadOrder`, the daily-summary line and the candidate-order line.

Measured by the delta review (6586977645 on the PR) over the window 2026-10-26T00:00Z → now: ① 19 cards opened by non-fleet authors; ② 56 of 1,694 cards closed in the window were opened by non-fleet authors (3.3%); ③ 16 open non-fleet cards with no `pm:*` state. The amendment changes none of the three today: the 8 seat-account cards in ③ and 4 in ① predate the one-line signature shape, so they still count as non-fleet.
